entry.name: Mozilla Firefox
entry.verified: SHA512SUMS.asc verified with gpg against the release's KEY (Mozilla Software Releases, primary fpr 14F26682D0916CDD81E37B6D61B7B526D98F0353); tarball SHA-512 matches SHA512SUMS; geckodriver .tar.gz.asc verified with the same Mozilla release key (subkey 09BEED63F3462A2DFFAB3B875ECB6497C1A20256); shared libs in ~/ibbrowsers/sysroot: CentOS 7 vault (yumdownloader --resolve) .rpms fetched from the distro repos, rpm -K OK on every package (distro GPG key in the system rpmdb), unpacked with rpm2cpio|cpio
entry.notes: driver is a wrapper that sources ~/ibbrowsers/env.sh (LD_LIBRARY_PATH -> ~/ibbrowsers/sysroot, FONTCONFIG_FILE -> ~/ibbrowsers/fonts.conf) then execs the real driver next to it. geckodriver: forward with the SAME local port as the remote --port (geckodriver rejects a Host header whose port differs: 'Invalid Host header 127.0.0.1:<otherport>').
